answer: A farm faces a waiting period of 26 days that no payment can shorten for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. The desk only stamps a name that carries Wickbound wick dipper ash writ, and the stamp itself rests on a writ wick dippers sign after chandler shop checks. lantern stays on the record. The nebula is checked, not assumed. One vine, one entry.
